summary: Exited on a new-low breach (-14.00pts) after three consecutive rounds of the same pattern: 1m/5m lambda_hat went significantly negative (predicting reversion), price partially recovered, then broke to a fresh, deeper low. Each 'recovery' failed to make a new favorable high while the lows kept extending (-9.25 -> -11.25 -> -14.00), which reads as a trending structure fighting the fade thesis rather than noise/chop, consistent with the strong up-momentum context seen in the 1h/4h/1D blocks at frame 0. Next time I'd watch for that specific signature earlier -- successive lower-lows with unchanged/failing recovery highs -- as an override to a still-significant but track-record-failing lambda reversion signal, rather than waiting for a third breach.
